cases.invariant: A tampered ledger.cost_delta must be detected
cases.detail: verifier exit=0 errors=[]

cases.invariant: A tampered ledger.fee must be detected against fills.fee
cases.detail: verifier exit=0 errors=[] (fee not reconciled)

cases.invariant: A tampered ledger.realized must make the verifier exit non-zero
cases.detail: verifier exit=0 errors=[] while total_pnl=999.00000000

cases.invariant: A tampered snapshots.equity must be detected or the curve marked unverified
cases.detail: verifier exit=0 errors=[] (equity curve unverified)

cases.invariant: An empty database must not be reported as 10 verified portfolios
cases.detail: hardcoded portfolios_checked=10 on an empty DB

cases.invariant: A movement referencing a nonexistent event must be reported
cases.detail: errors=[] (dangling FK invisible; schema has no FK)

cases.invariant: A movement whose leg is absent from its event payload must be reported
cases.detail: errors=[] (extra leg invisible)

cases.invariant: A source_effects row pointing at a nonexistent event must be reported
cases.detail: errors=[] (orphan effect invisible)

cases.invariant: A movement with no reachable event must be reported by row identity
cases.detail: errors=[] source_cash=0 (orphan invisible)

cases.invariant: A 3-way fan-out with no condition/outcome mapping must be quarantined
cases.detail: unspecified 3-way split state=applied

cases.invariant: A split with no complementary outcome must be quarantined, not applied
cases.detail: single-sided split state=applied

cases.invariant: A split consuming no paid basis must be quarantined (cannot mint inventory)
cases.detail: zero-basis split state=applied; 0 == 0 satisfies the paid-basis identity

cases.invariant: A redemption leg paying negative cash must not be applied as a payout
cases.detail: negative-cash redemption state=applied

cases.invariant: A payout above one unit per share with no proof must be quarantined
cases.detail: unproved redemption state=applied

cases.invariant: A conflict must leave an immutable record; state flip alone is insufficient
cases.detail: no append-only conflict evidence: the conflicting payload is absent from every non-state table (34 checked); only mutable state/review rows exist

cases.invariant: A conflicting certificate payload must be durably retrievable after the conflict
cases.detail: conflicting payload not retained in any of 36 tables

cases.invariant: All three received retry bodies must be durable after total failure
cases.detail: durable bodies=['body-3'] (expected all 3)

cases.invariant: An attempt log with no last_raw (pre-response failure) must still be durable
cases.detail: durable bodies=[]; nothing persisted at all

cases.invariant: A successful response received before a later failure must remain durable
cases.detail: durable bodies=['bad-504']; the successful body was destroyed

cases.invariant: A completed walk must not be published as the requested scope's frontier
cases.detail: frontier published for a CLOSED walk under an OPEN request: [{'wallet': 'fixture-wallet', 'endpoint': '/v2/positions', 'batch': 1, 'captured_at': 1793884422.9590044, 'coverage': 'captured pages only; late inserts and source completeness unproven'}]

cases.invariant: A pending CLOSED walk must not be sent as the caller's OPEN request
cases.detail: OPEN request was sent as status=CLOSED

cases.invariant: A BLOB and the TEXT of its own Python repr must not collide through default=str
cases.detail: collision: blob and text share digest fe21b3a17c7cc0eb (default=str renders bytes as the text b"..." )

cases.invariant: BLOB b"A" and TEXT "b'A'" must produce different digests (default=str collision)
cases.detail: collision: blob and text(text) share digest fe21b3a17c7cc0eb

cases.invariant: A ts=0 ok=1 health row must not render as Healthy
cases.detail: stale ts=0 row rendered as 'Healthy'

cases.invariant: A backup must not proceed while another process holds writer ownership
cases.detail: backup succeeded while another owner held the worker lock

cases.invariant: A DB reached via symlink must use the same worker lock as the real path
cases.detail: symlinked path acquired a SECOND exclusive lock: two owners possible

cases.invariant: While another owner holds the worker lock, a second Store must refuse or be read-only
cases.detail: a second Store() became a WRITER while the owner held the worker lock; Store() itself is not ownership-aware, so safety depends on every caller remembering to flock

cases.invariant: The verifier report must identify the database it verified (hash)
cases.detail: verifier report does not bind the verified database bytes (no sha256 44e9b382070d...); findings cannot be attributed to a snapshot

cases.invariant: If the signing-code scan finds no source files it must error, not silently pass
cases.detail: exit=0 errors=[] - scan silently empty when cwd has no lab/

cases.invariant: Two successive holds must leave both reasons retrievable
cases.detail: hold history overwritten: final visible reasons={'gap B'}

cases.invariant: There must be a release path that records who released and on what evidence
cases.detail: no hold-release mechanism or release record exists in code or schema
